summary.text: Dean Tarulli is the Democratic candidate for the New York State Assembly, District 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Glen Head resident who has spent more than 15 years administering infrastructure, clean water and environmental projects, and who is now Deputy Director of Coastal Resilience for New York City.

paragraphs.text: Tarulli lists a bachelor's degree from Stony Brook University, awarded in 2012, and North Shore High School as his schooling.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he studied marine science at Stony Brook and began his career at the state Department of Environmental Conservation.
He said he later worked on the $125 million Living with the Bay project in Nassau County and on Westchester County's flood mitigation capital plan.

He also said that after Hurricane Sandy the state put him in charge of safeguarding more than $500 million in federal disaster-recovery funds, and that he now oversees more than $1.6 billion in infrastructure as Deputy Director of Coastal Resilience for New York City.

In the same survey, Tarulli said his priorities include increasing High Tax Aid for schools, housing policy set by local communities rather than state mandates, and stronger oversight of state spending.
He also described a plan to expand New York communities' participation in the federal Community Rating System to lower flood insurance premiums.
He listed 314 Action as an endorser.
